tei:div.tei:p: ༄/ tshe sgrub gnam lcags rdo rje'i cha rkyen du gyur pa bka' brgyad dngos grub snying po'i dbang chog bzhugs so// 86)na mo gu ru sa mā dā na ye/ dmigs med spros bral kun bzang nam mkha' cher/ 'gag med gzugs sku che mdachog nyi 'od rgyas/ rol rtsal bdun brgya nyer lnga'i 'od zer tshogs/ spro mkhas padma thod phreng la gtud de/ sgrub pa bka' brgyad 'o mtsho bsub pa'i bcud/ dngos grub snying po bdud rtsi'i yang zhun gyis/ skal bzang nod ldan 'dod ba 'jo ba'i dbang*/ ji ltar bya thabs gsal bar 'dir bshad nyon/ ༈ de la gsum ste/ dang por dkyil 'khor dbang rdzas kyi bkod pa gang ltar bya ba/ bar du snyen sgrub gzhung srong gi byin rlabs nus land du sgrub pa/ tha mar slob ma rjes 'dzin gyi dbang bskur ji ltar bya tshul dag gsum gyi dang po ni/ mod rgyud man ngag la mkhas shing lta dgongs ting 'dzin dam tshig sdom 87) ldan gyi bla ma sgrub pa bka' brgyad la nus pa thob pa gang der/ dad ldan gtong phod brtson grus nges 'byung gi blo dang ldan pa'i slob ma theg mchog bla mied kyi snod rung gi snying thag pa nas gsol ba btab pa'i dus bzang po nyid la/ 'gal rkyen gyis dben zhing mthun rkyen tshang la yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su/ sa'i cho ga dang stegs bu bzhengs pa thig tshon byin rlabs sogs kyi las rim rgyas par spro na sgrub pa bka' brgyad gter snying gzhan nas blangs kyang rung la/ gter kha 'di nyid ltar na zhi khro nges don snying po'i sgrub khog chen mo nas gsungs pa bzhin bya zhing*/ rdul tshon dag ras bris lta bu la ni 'grub na dkyil 'khor ming tshe dgu re re la'ang rta babs yongs su rdzogs pa'i pho brang nyi ma dgu shar du grags pa nid dang*/ 88) de ltar yang grus na phyi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi ltar bar ling tshe dgu thim btab pa'i nang so sor gser gyi 'khor lo rtsab bzhi pa'i stengs mthing nag

mu khyud nang ma dmar po phyi ma sngon po rtsis mtshan ljang khu/ re mig dgu'i bar bcad rnams steng gi rdo rjes gdung mig yang ris kyis dbyibs can/ bar 'khyams dang gi bzhi phyogs modag sogs re gzhan thams cad spyi matun las phyogs pa cer bum gdan bum sa bre chos 'khor char khobs nyi zla rog dang bcas pa mchod rjen gyi ltar yod pa dang*/ phyi'i 'khor yug la'ang dur khrod kyi phyi rim la khyad par du 'khor lo rtsibs stong cing*/ 'og nas padma 'dab stong brdal ba mtha' skor rdo rje'i brag gi btams pa dang bcas pa'i mtshon byed rnams kyi sgrub pa bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor gyi khyad chos yin pa dang*/ phyi mthar ye shes lha ldan gyi me'i ra ba dang bcas te/ mdor na bka' brgyad kyi thig rtsa tshul bzhin shes pa'i phyag bzhes mthong rgyud ltar bri'o/ dbus kyi lte bar yang zla gam dmar po sgo gcig pa'i dkyil du chos sku 'gyur med kyi e gru gsum mthing nag gis mtshan pa dang bcas pa bya la/ yang*/ rdul tshon sogs ma grub 89) ba'al/ spros pa nyer bsdu'i dkyil 'khor byed na/ dri bzang bdud rtsi dzā gad kyis sbags pa'i 'grub ba'i tshom bu dgu bkod pas kyang rung ba nyid do/ dbang rdzas ni dkyil 'khor gyi khar khri rkang ngam man rji'i steng du zangs gzhong chen me 'bru mis bkang ba'am yag na lcegs rtse sogs ci rigs kyi steng du/ bum pa mtshan mgul 'chings mthing ga can sa rgyan gzungs thag rdo rje sogs dang ldan lnga tshan lnga chu dang bcas pas bum pa'i gsum gnis gang bar dbyas pa dbus su bzhag mtha' skor rnams su che mchog dpal dgu khyung chen dkar nag dang bcas pa'i sku rten tsakka med dang*/ rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan/ rdo rje dril bu/ raksha'am thos pa'i khrid la/ lcags phur/ gsang dbang gi thod pa bdud rtsis mngar gsum chos sman rnams sbyar ba/ shen dag gi dmigs rten gzungs ma'i gzugs sam rdo rje bag me sum chen gnam zhal gyi bris sku gang rigs/

tshig dbang gi me lo shel rdo dang bcas pa rnams dgod/ gzhan yang khro bo'i rgyan chas stag sham ko rlon g.yang gzhi thod phreng sbrul chun thal zhag khrag gsum gyi byug rdzas rnams kyang dngos sam gzugs 90) bris ji ltar 'byor pa yang bsham/ dkyil 'khor mtha' skor du sman rag dpal dgu'i gtor ma dang bla ma mkha' 'gro chos srung gzhi bdag sogs kyi gtor ma yang ci 'byor pa tshogs kyis longs spyod dang*/ thun mong gis mchod pa bya sgom pa spyan gzigs bkod pa'i khyad par sna tshogs kyis mdzes shing byin chags par bshamapa shi dang por bya ba'i las rim mo/ ༈ gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon 'khor bcas bde ba'i ldan la 'khod nas/ nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can gyi don 'ba' zhig sa'i sems skyed dang ldan pas thun mong gi skyabs sems tshogs bsags kyi rim pa spyi ltar ram/ gter chos 'di nyid kyi bi ma'i chos spyod chen mo ltar bya/ de nas bka' brgyad 'di ga'i las gzhung gi lta ba'i mtshams gcod nas bzungs te 'dzab kyi rim pa la thug gi bar du khyer sgom zung 'jug tu byas la/ bdag mdun dus gcig tu gsal gdab pa'i sna tshogs gtso bo dpal chen dgu la rang rang gi 'khor rnams nyi ma dang 'od gnyis mi 'bral ba'i ngang tshul ltar chos pas bskyed/ bum pa'i nang du'ang dkyil 'khor ling tshe dgu par lha tshogs ma tshang ba med par mi long du gzugs brnyan shar ba bzhin gsal nas rang 91) gi spyan 'dren mtshad bstod thams cad bdag mdun bum pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum khar stab gcig tu bya/ ༈ 'dzab kyi skabs la tse/ lha rnams kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor kyi steng du hūm̐ yig so so'i sku mdog dang mthun pa'i sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar dmigs shing las byang nas 'byung ba ltar gyi dpal dgu'i snying po dang*/ mthar spyi dril gyi 'dzab bzlas pa ni bsnyen pa/ de ltar bzlas tshe thugs srog sa bon dang sngags 'phreng las 'od zer dpag med 'phros pas rgyal ba rab 'byams la mchod pa phul zhing*/

khams gsum sems can gyi las sgrib sbyang ste thams cad dpal chen he ru ka'i lha tshogs 'ba' zhig tu gyur nanas stong khams thams cad sngags kyi rang sgras 'ur der du 'gyur par bsam pa ni dbugs phyir rgyu bkang sprad/ yang dbugs nang du 'jug tshe phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba ma lus pa'i byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub gzi byin nus mthu mtha' dag 'od zer gyi rnam pa 'bru gsum yi ge'i tshul du tshur byung nas bdag mdun bum pa'i lha'i gnas gsum du thim par mos pa ste/ de ltar spro bsdu'i bzlas pa byed pa ni sgrub pa/ de lta bu'i bdag mdun gyi 92) bskyed bzlas spro bsdu sogs de dag thams cad kyang don de bar bya byed las gsum dbyer med dkun bzang che mchog gi dgongs klong rnam par dag pa kho na'i rol pa nyid las gzhan du ma yin par thag chod pas/ gdod nas ma bcings ma grol ba'i ting 'dzin skun 'byams kyi ngang nas lha sngags sems gsum tha dad med par 'jog pa ni sgrub pa chen po ste/ de ltar bsnyen dang sgrub pa sgrub chen gsum gcig dril gyi nyams su len tshul 'di ni bka' brgyad nyid kyi dgongs su thun mong ma yin pa'i skabs don yin la/ gsang sngags gyi gzhung lugs spyi dang bye brag pa'i bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i 'chad tshul 'di dang mi 'dra ba mtha' yas pa yod tshe/ the tshom gyi mgo 'khor mi ltang bar bya'o/ de ltar 'dzab bsnyen stong phrag tsam gyis bar 'bar du stong tshims kyi mchod bstod bya zhing*/ gzhan yang tshogs mchod bsgral stabs bskang ba sogasargyas par byas nas sgrub ste/ mthar mdun bskyed lha tshogs kyi gnas gsum 'bru gsum las 'od 'phros pa'i 'od zer bdag nyid kyi gnas gsum du 'drim pas dbang gzhi blangs shing bdag nyid lha dang dbyer med pa'i nges shos 93) skyed do/ 'di dag ni bar du byin rlabs nus ldan du bya ba'i las rim mo/

༈ gsum pa slob ma rjes 'dzin dngos kyi las rim ni/ slob ma ji tsam yod pa dag sgo drung nas las slob kyis yig brgya'i gzungs chus grus byar gzhug la nang du phyag byas nas bral du 'khod de maṇḍal rgyas par phul ba'i mjug tu slob dpon gyis yid ches bskyed pa'i rgyus 'chad pa ni/ ༈ nga ni rdo rje'i rdzong chen te/ 'khor ba'i g.yul chen dmag dpungs las/ 'gro ba'i 'khras par dam bcas kyi/ gang zhig mthar 'dod lam 'dir shog 'khor ba'i snying po sbyang ba'i phyir/ nga yi cho 'phrul byin rlabs kyis/ bstan pa'i snying po dam pa zhig skal ldan khyod la bstan pa bya/ de'i phyir nam mkha' rab 'byams kyi mthar khyab pa'i 'gro ba rnam pa sna tshogs pa mtha' dag bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub la myur du 'khor par bya phyir/ bde gshegs sgrub pa bka' 94)brgyad kyi dbang bskur zab o zhu bar bgyi snyam pa'i thugs skyed dang ldan pas rtog pa gzhan du yengs pa sogs chos nyan pa'i mi mthun phyogs kun spangs te gsan 'tshal/ de yang rang gzhan gyi don chen tshe gcig sangs rgyas sgrub pa la theg chen gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam zab mo smin grol gnyis la ma brten par thabs gzhan gyis thob par mi 'gyur zhing*/ 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa ni ji ltar u dum wa ra'i me tog dang mtshungs pa shin tu bkon zhing rnyed par dka' ste/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams gang ga'i klung gi bye ma snyed rnams su yang rgyu'i theg pa sdo snod gsum gyis gdul bya 'dul ba 'ba' zhig las/ 'bras bu'i theg pa dar ba'i zhing ni 'ga' tsam las ma mchis te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sangs rgyas rnams 95)ni gdul bya la nye ring phyogs cha'am chos la sba sri dang dpe 'khyud du mdzad pa ma yin mod kyang*/ sems can rnams bsod nams dang skal ba bzang po theg mchog zab mo'i snod du gyur pa shin tu dkon pa'i dbang las so/

de bas na 'o skal mi 'jed kyi zhing dang de las khyad par 'dzam gling 'di kho na gsang sngags kyi chos 'byung ba'i skal ba can 'dir skyes pa dang*/ 'das ma 'ong kyi sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul rgya mtsho rgyud mar byin pa rnams kyi ma gsungs ma grags pa'i zab mo rdo rje theg pa'i yang bcud bcom ldan 'das shākya' dbang po kho na'i bstan pa 'di la byung zhing rang cag gis spyod du yod pa 'di ni dbul pos yid bzhin gyi nor bu brnyed pa yis kyang 'gran du ga la bzod cing dpe dang rgyu'i char yang mi phod la/ 'di lta bu dang mjal ba'i skal 96)bzang dang bsod nams yod bzhin du tshe gcig sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs la brtson zhing 'bad par mi byed na ni/ rgya mtsho'i tshong pa rin po che'i gling du phyin nas stong par log pa las ches cher blun par 'gyur bas na/ da lta phun tshogs snod bcud 'dzom dus gzhi dad pa brtan po'i rmang bting*/ grogs brtson 'grus drag pos rgyud bskul/ rkyen bla ma mtshan ldan gyis sna drangs/ lam nyame lan zab mo'i gzhung tshugs thabs smin grol gnad kyi kha bsgyur/ rgyud dam tshig gtsang mas mtshams sbyar te/ 'khor ba dang gtan dgyes kyi 'dun zhig dang res sgrub dgos pa lags/ de lta bu sgrub par bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs bka' rgya che/ lung grangs mang*/ man ngag gting mtha' med pa gcig mchis mod kyang mdor bsdu na/ rgyu'i theg pa las sde snod gsum dang 'bras bu'i theg pa la rgyud sde bzhi'am drug gi rim par 'dus 97)shing*/ de thams cad kyi snying po ni skyed rdzogs sgrub pa bka' brgyad la ma 'dus pa ni gang yang ma mchis pa dang*/ de rnams kyi don ji ltar 'ud zhe na/ chos 'di lta bus gang zag gi ngar 'dzin gyi rtog pa 'dul bas na 'dul ba yang yin la gdams pa'i zab gnad mdor bsdus pas na mdo sde dang*/ bden gnyis dbyer med rang byung med rang byung ye shes mngon du byed pas na mngon pa ste/

rgyu'i theg pa sdo snod gsum po 'di don gyis tshang ba dang*/ 'bras bu'i theg pa'i rgyud sde bzhi yang tshang ste/ 'khor 'das sku gsum gyi rol par 'char ba byed pas bya ba rig gsum yi rgyud dang*/ bde chen gnyis skyed rdzogs kyi lam du 'khyer bas spyod rgyud gnyis ldan dang gsal stong zung ngag tu sbyor bas yo ga rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang*/ chos nyid ji bzhin pa'i don la bde blag tu sbyor bas rnal 'byor bla med kyi 98)theg pa'i mchog rab kyang yin no/ rgyud lung man ngag gsum gyi don yang 'dir 'du ste/ sbyang gzhi gtso bor ston pa'i skor ni rgyud la hā yo ga sbyang thabs gtso tsher ston pa rnams ni lung a nu yo ga sbyong byed gtso bor ston pa'i skor ni man ngag a ti yo ga ste/ de thams cad kyi dgongs pa'i gnad don mus 'dir lus shing tshang ba yin pas na gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa lags/ ༈ de lta bu gsang sngags sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi chos skor 'di nyid byung tshul lo rgyus kyi dbang du bgyi na/ brgyud pa'i babs tshul lnga'i sgo nas ston te/ rgyal ba dgongs pas brgyud pa/ rig 'dzin brda yi rgyud pa/ mkha' 'gro gtad brgya'i brgyud/ gang zag snyan khung gi brgyud pa/ smon lam dbang bskur gyi rgyud pa dang lnga las/ dang po rgyal ba dgongs brgyud ni/ 'khor 'das gang du yang ma grub pa'i 99)sngon rol nas rang byung gdod ma'i mgon po ye thog dang po'i sangs rgyas 'khor 'das kun gyi byed po'am 'byung gnas su gyur pa/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi sprul gzhi'am khyab bdag dam pa dpal kun tu bzang po de nyid chos kyi dbyings med par bzhugs pa'i ngang nas/ gdul bya dang 'dul byed tha dad du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa mi mnga' yang*/ ye shes rang byung gi thugs rje dang 'gro ba'i smon lam mos pa rgya mtsho gzhi matun pa'i rtel 'brel las gdul bya'i chags sdang gi blo rtog gzhom phyir gzugs sku zhi khro gnyis ki sgyu 'phrul ye shes kyi sku'i dkyil 'khor mngon par snang ba ni/

zhi tshul gyi 'dul ba la rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas yab yum dag drug 100)pa rdo rje 'chang chen po la sogs dang*/ khro bo'i rnam 'gyur gyis 'dul ba la dpal chen po he ru ka 'khor lo bde ba'i mchog gi dra ba sdom pa ces kyang bya/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dgyes mdzad rdo rje zhes kyang bya/ gsang ba'i bdag nyid thams cad 'dus pa'i he ru ka ces kyang bya/ bla med gsang ba mchog gi rdo rje che mchog dbang gi rgyal po kun bzang he ru ka ces kyang bya ba ste/ dbu dang phyag zhabs mtha' yas shing sprul pa'i rol gar bsam mi khyab pa'i rdzu 'phrul las nyid la mi gzhan pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor til gyi gang baya kha phye ba bzhin sprul pa dag la/ chos thams cad kyi snying po bde bar gshegs pa thams cad 'dus pa'i rgyud lung man ngag rnams/ brjod pa sgra tshig ngag gi bya rtsol ma yin par rang byung rang gsal rang grol gyi dgongs pa gtso 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ngang nas zab 101)gsal chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi 'chad par dus gsum dus med du bzhugs pas na rgyal ba dgongs pa'i rgyud pa ces byas ste sangs rgyas kho na'i spyod yul gyi mtshan nyid yin no/ ༈ gnyis pa rig 'dzin brda'i rgyud pa ni/ ston pa'i ston pa chos kyi skun kun bzang che mchog he ru ka nyid kyi thugs rje'i rang rtsal las bka'i sdud pa byang sems rig 'dzin gyi tshogs mngon par sprul te/ de yang rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin dang*/ tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin/ lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin/ phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin/ sa la gnas pa'i rig 'dzin la sogs sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi rig 'dzin dpag tu med pa rnams kyi yon tan pa'i thugs rang byung gi ye shes kyi klong nas ting nge 'dzin gyi gzigs stangs dang 'od zer dang phyag rgya sogs brda tsam bstan ma 102)thag don gyi dgongs gsang ma lus pa ji lta ba rtogs shing mngon du mdzad pa las sgra tshig mtshan ma'i spros pa la ltos mi dgos pa ni yon tan 'khor ngo bi gcig pa'i don gyi na dgongs pa la khyad par med cing*/

bka'i bathu ba mdzad pa rnams la ma gtogs log rtogs phyogs rtogs kyi skyon gyi dri ma rdul cha phra mo tsam gyis kyang dgos pa med pa yin la/ de lta bu rig pa 'dzin pa chen po rnams kyi nang nas kyang gtso bo lta bur gyur pa mtshan gyi rnam grangs su rdo rje chos dang*/ ro rje snying po dang*/ rdo rje thod pa rtsal dang*/ lag na rdo rje 'chang ba dang*/ rig 'dzin gyi rgul po kuñdza ra zhes kyang bya ba zhig ston pa nyid kyi thugs las sprul te gsang sngags rgyud sde rab 'byams kun gyi bdag por dbang bskur bar mdzad pa 'di ni yongs grags kyi mtshan don du dpal gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na 103)rdo rje nyid yin te/ des bde bar gshegs pa thams cad dbus pa'i chos bka' rtsa ba dang yan lag gi rgyud sde zab cing rgya che ba bcud kyi snying po'i yang zhun du gyur pa rnams gser gyi glegs bu la bai ḍūrya zhun mas yi ger btab ching rin po che sna tshogs kyi sgrom bum bcug nas rgyas btab te gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin pa'i ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams la gter du gdams par mdzad pa ni rig 'dzin brda'i brgyud pa ces bya'o/ gsum pa mkha' 'gro gtad rgya'i brgyud pa ni/ de ltar rig 'dzin gyi gtso mchog rdo rje chos kyis gsang ba zab mo'i rgyud sde rnams ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma spyi dang khyad par mkha' 'gro kun gyi gtso mo rdo rje phag mo'am bdag med lha mo'am nyi zla thod phreng ma'am mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang mo che zhes mtshan gyi rnam grangs du mar grags pa la ched du gdams te/ kye/ mkha' 'gro ma gsang 104)ba'i mdzod 'chang ba khyod rnams kyi yid bzhin nor bu dbang gi rgyal po las lhag pa'i rgyud sde rin po che 'di dag da lta spel ba'i snod dang yul du gyur pa ma mchis pas zab mo'i gter du sdoms la/ ma 'ong bskal pa rtsod ldan gyi dus su 'di dag 'dzam gling mi yul du snang bar byed pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa 'ga' zhig bdag gi thugs rje'i 'od zer las sprul nas yul gru tha dad pa'i 'gro ba'i 'dren par 'byung ba rnams la rang rang gi rig dang mthun pa'i chos bka' rnams so sor gtod cig

ces bka' stsal pa bzhin ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma las kyi dbang chen la sogs pas rgyud sde rnams sde tshan so sor phyes te rin po che'i kha dog rig dang mthun pa'i sgrom bur stsal ba la rgya rim pa dgu yis btab nas/ 'dzam gling gi lte ba rdo rje gdan dag nye ba mchog gi dngos grub bde blag tu thob par 105)'gyur ba'i gnas dur khrod chen po bsil ba tshal lam ro myag 'dam bu'i tshal zhes bya ba de'i dbus su rang byung gi mchod rten bde byed rtsegs pa'i nang du gter du bzhugs su gsol te/ de yang*/ mchod rten gyi rmang la zug pa rtsa ba'i tshul du sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i rtsa ba dang yan lag gi rgyud sde rnams dang*/ bang rim la gyes pa mal ga'i tshul du sgrub pa bka' brgyad bye brag pa'i rgyud sde bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bzhugs pa'i sgrom bu brgyad po phyogs mtshams brgyad du sbas/ bum par brgyad pa lo 'dab kyi tshul du bde bar gshegs pa thams cad 'dus pa'i spyi rgyud tshang bar rin chen sna lnga'i sbrom bur sbas/ bre la gsal ba me tog gi tshul du gsang ba yongs rdzogs 'dus pa'i rgyud chen ni rin chen shel gyi bum par sbas/ 'khor lo la smin pa 'bras bu'i tshul du rang byung rang shar rtsa 106)ba yan lag gi rgyud rnams bai ḍūrya'i bum par sbas/ tog la bcud kyi snying po'i tshul du a ti rdzogs pa chen po sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang*/ kun tu bzang po'i dgongs zangs tham du ston pa la sogs zab don snying po'i skor rnams nor bu rin po che 'od kyi snying po'i ga'ur sbas shing*/ de lta bu'i mchod rten chen po de la ye shes dang las la grub pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dag 'jig rten khams kyi lha ma srin sde brgyad kun gyi nyin mtshan du phyag skor mchod pa bkur sti byed pas dus 'da' bar 'gyur to/ de nas thub pa chen po mya ngan las 'das nas mi lo lnga brgyar nye ba na/

gsang ba'i bdag po rig 'dzin rdo rje chos kyi sprul pa bkye ba'i dus la babs par gzigs nas/ thugs chos dbyings rnam par dag pa'i rol rtsal ye shes dgu las rig 'dzin rnam pa dgur sprul par mdzad de/ ye shes dgu gang zhe na/ chos 107)dbyings/ me long*/ mnyam nyid/ sor rtogs/ bya grub te ye shes lnga dang*/ stong nyid ye shes/ 'da' bka' ye shes dbyings sgrol ye shes/ klong gyur ye shes te/ ye shes dgu'i sgyu 'phrul gyi sku rig 'dzin rnam pa dgur byon zhing*/ so so nas thos bsam sgom pa'i 'bras bu mthar son nas grub pa mchog gi sa la bzhugs bzhin pas mngon par mkhyen pa'i gzigs pa gcig tu mthun par dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal gyi mchod rten du gsang sngags rgyad sde rab 'byams kyi chos gter ji ltar bzhugs pa dang*/ de dag mi yul gyi gdul bya la spel ba'i dus la nye bar babs pa yang dgos pa gcig tu gzhol te/ rig 'dzin chen po dgu rnams dus gcig tu mchod rten gyi drung du zhal 'dzom zhing tshogs 'khor rgya cher bshams te gsol ba mgrin gcig tu btab pas/ rdo rje phag mo las kyi dbang 108)mo che 'khor dang bcas pas zab mo'i chos gter gyi rgya dkrol nas/ rig 'dzin dgu la bdang bskur zhing byin gyis brlabs pas rgyud mung man ngag gi dgongs pa mngon du gyur par mdzad pa'i mthar so so'i rigs dang mthun pa'i sgrub pa bka' brgyad bye brag pa'i rgyud kyi gter sgrom rnams gtad de/ de yang*/ 'jam dpal sku'i rgyud le'u khyi drug stong pa dang*/ zla gsang nag po le'u 'bum pa dang*/ gzhon nu gdong drug me lce phreng ba/ rdo rje thog 'bebs/ me rlung skyin thang 'khrug pa la sogs mdor na 'jam dpal zhi khro spyi dang bye brag gi rgyud sde rnams bse sgrom smug po'i nang du bzhugs pa de nyid/ sku'i rig 'dzin 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la bka' bab pa la brten nas/

rgyal ba'i dgongs don mus 'jam dpal gshin rje 'khor lo rnam pa bzhir bsdus te/ gdul bya 109)rnams smin grol gyi lam la bkod/ de bzhin du/ padma gsung gi rgyud rta mchog rol pa/ rngog ma les rgan/ dbang chen 'dus pa/ spu gri gsang ba/ dregs pa dang tshar gcod/ yang gsang khros pa/ nā na klu 'dul sogs rta mgrin dbang gi rgyud dpag tu med pa zangs kyi sgrom bur bzhugs pa de gsung gi rig 'dzin klu sgrub snying po la bka' babs pas gsang sngags kyi dgongs don thams cad kyi dbang chen rta skad thang gsum gyi dgongs par bsdus nas gdul bya 'dul bar mdzad yang dag thugs kyi rgyud khrag 'thung 'dus pa che chung*/ gal po che chung*/ 'jig rten 'das mod/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ zla gsang thig le/ gsang ba 'dus pa/ ye shes rngams pa glog gi 'khor lo sogs mdo bzhi dem lnga la sogs pa'i rgyud sde mtha' yas pa rnams dngul gyi sgrom 110)bur bzhugs pa ni thugs kyi rig 'dzin hūm̐ ka ra la babs pas// chos thams cad ru lu 'bru brgyad kyi dgongs par bsdus nas sems can gyi don mdzad/ bdud raci yon tan gyi bdud rtsi bam po brgyad pa/ bdud rtsi 'khor lo 'bar ba/ bdud rtsi phreng ba/ bdud rtsi'i bum pa/ bdud rtsi rol pa che chung*/ rnam dag dri med/ dngos grub gter mdzod/ bdud rtsi thig pa/ dngos grub nye ba'i snying po/ bdud rtsi las rgya mtsho la sogs bdud rtsi sman gyi rgyud sde grangs med pa rin chen gser gyi sgrom bur bzhugs pa ni che mchog yon tan gyi rig 'dzin bi ma mi dra'i phyag tu babs pa/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad bdud rtsi rnam dag gi dgongs par gtan la phebs nas skal ldan grol du mdzad/ phur pa phrin las kyi rgyud bi to tā mā la 'bum sde las/ rdo rje rtse mo/ ye shes rtse mo/ sangs rgyas rtse mo/ myang 'das che chung*/ gsang ba'i 111)dgongs rgyud/

dam pa gsang chen/ kī la ya bcu gnyis 'byung ba la sogs phur pa rtsa ba'i rgyud drug yan lag gi rgyud nyer bdun/ gtso bo lta bu'i rgyud lnga/ yal gi'i rgyud bcu/ lo ma'i rgyud bzhi/ me tog gi rgyud bcu/ 'bras bu'i rgyud bzhi/ snying po'i rgyud gsum/ kha skong gi rgyud bdun/ phra mo'i rgyud bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pa lcags kyi sgrom bur bzhugs pa ni phrin las kyi rig 'dzin pra bha hasti la bka' babs pas/ chos thams cad dug gsum sku gsum du sgrol bar byed pa phur bu thal 'byin gyi dgongs pas 'gro ba 'dul bar mdzad/ srid pa ma mo'i rgyud la/ ma mo 'bum tig rtsa ba'i rgyud la le'u brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ de'i rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa'i ma mo srid pa'i sems chen dang gsang ba gtan tshig le'u 'bum pa sogs 112)spyi'i rgyud dang*/ bye brag tu/ sku rgyud 'bum tig yang snying*/ gsung rgyud lam rgyud dang las rgyud/ thugs rgyu ma mo gsang mdzod dang*/ sgo rgyud la dkar mo sku'i rgyud dgu smug po gsung gi rgyud lnga/ nag mo thugs kyi rgyud bdun dang*/ ser mo yon tan dang ljang mo phrin las kyi rgyud sogs dpag tu med pa rnams mu men gyi sgrom bur bzhugs pa ni/ dbyings kyi rig 'dzin dha na saṃskṛ la bka' babs pa/ gsang sngags kyi lam mtha' dag rtsa rlung rnam dag gi dgongs par bsdus nas skal ldan byang grol la 'god par mdzad/ ༈ 'jig rten dregs byed 'dul ba'i rgyud kyi skod la/ dregs pa 'dus pa sku'i rgyud/ ngan sngags nag po gsung gi rgyud/ srog tig nag po thugs kyi rgyud/ yon tan dregs pa'i gtor rgyud/ phrin las dregs pa'i las rgyud sogs spyi'i 113)rgyud dang*/ bye brag tu dregs byed sde dpon sum cu so so'i sgos rgyud grangs med pa dang bcas pa rnams rin chen mchog gi sgrom bur bzhugs pa ni/ dregs pa kun 'dul gyi slob dpon de wa tsand+ra'i phyag tu babs pas/

'khor 'das thams cad lta ba'i rdzong dang sgom pa'i 'phrang gnyis la bsdus te gtan la phab par mdzad do/ ༈ dmod pa drag sngags kyi skor la shel 'phreng dkar po sku'i rgyud/ drag sngags 'dus pa gsung gi rgyud/ tsitta dmar 'byin thugs kyi rgyud/ gter mdzod chen po yon gyi rgyud/ las mtha' snang tshogs ston pa phrin las kyi rgyud sogs drag sngags spyi'i rgyud/ sngags bdag dregs pa bco brgyad so so'i sgos rgyud mtha' yas pa dang bcas pa rnams phra men gzi'i sgrom bur bzhugs pa ni drag sngags kyi rig 'dzin shintaṃ garbha la bka' 114)babs pas/ bstan srung gi drag las thams cad kyi snying po'i gnad ni dregs pa'i srog snying dang phrog thabs gnad kyi man ngag gnyis la bsdus nas 'gal byed cham la dbab pa'i phrin las la mnga' brnyes/ de lta bu sgrub pa bka' brgyad po thams cad kyi spyi rgyud sde lnga kha skong gi lung chen lnga/ bye brag gis sgos rgyud bcu la sogs pa bde bar gshegs pa thams cad 'dus pa'i rgyud sde rnams dang*/ gzhan las/ zhi khro sgyu 'phrul gyi skor dang*/ yongs rdzogs gsang 'dus/ rang byung rang shar/ mnyam sbyor ma bu/ dgongs pa zangs thal sogs tshes gcig sangs rgyas kyi zab don mthar thug pa'i rgyud sde'i snying po thams cad ni kun 'dus kyi rig 'dzin padma sambha wa nyid la bka' babs shing*/ chos thams cad dgongs pa'i klong nas rang shar yang gdul bya'i snang ngor sgrub pa sde brgyad kyi rig 'dzin 115)so so dang yang gdams pa gsan res dang man ngag gi dgongs nyams bdud ba'i tshul gyi sgro 'dogs gting chod du mdzad/ slob dpon brgyad po de dag so sos kyang rang rang la ji ltar bka' babs pa'i rgyud sde rnams la brten nas dngos grub rnam gnyis yongs su brnyes shing rgyud rnams kyi dgongs pa 'grol ba'i bstan bcos 'grel ṭika sgrub thabs lag len man ngag las tshogs sogs rgya cher mdzad nas gdul bya'i skal ba dang mtshams pa'i chos kyi phrin las mtha' yas pa ji ltar spel ba'i lo rgyus ni brjod kyi mi lang mod na'ang 'di skabs kyi brjod bya'i snying po ni/

slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas nyid bod yul mtha' khob mun pa'i gling du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sgron me sbar bar mdzad pa'i slad du byon pa yan chad 116)kyi skor gong du smos pa 'di dag ni mkha' 'gro gtad rgya'i brgyud pa ces bya ba yin no/ ༈ bzhi pa gang zag snyan khung gi rgyud tshul ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyi gzugs rig 'dzin grub thob mus pa'i gtso bor gyur pa'i gu ru rin po che padma 'byung gnas de nyid kyis/ bsam yas mtshims phu brag dmar ske tshang gi sgrub gnas su bde bar gshegs pa thams cad sgrub pa sde dgu la yongs su 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po zhal phyes nas/ skal ldan rje 'bangs snying gi bu dgu la dbang bskur ba'i dus su/ rang rang gi tshe rabs kyi lha skal la me tog cod paṇa ji ltar babs pa dang mthun pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi zhal mthong zhing dngos grub kyi mtshan ma gang ltar brnyes pa ni rje mnga' dbag khri srong lde btsan gyi me tog dbus kyi gtso bo la babs pas/ dkyil 'khor chen po gcig gi steng du sgrub pa 117)bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor tshang la ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs pa dang lha tshogs bdun brgya nyer lnga me long nang gi gzugs brnyen ltar bkra lam mer mthong zhing*/ de thams cad rang sems thig le nyag gcig ngang du dbyer med par rtogs par byung la/ 'on kyang rgyal po 'jig rten gyi g.yeng ba che bas tshe der mchog gi grub pa ma thob kyang skye ba'i rim pa bcu gsum par sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi gter gyi bdag por gyur nas rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par lung bstan zhing byin gyis rlabs/ slob ma gzhan bdun gyis ni phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang sems mtha' dag rang rang gi me tog phog pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs de'i rang bzhin du rdzogs pa'i zhal mthong zhing nges shes thob la/ jo mo mtsho rgyal gyis ni sangs rgyas kyi dkyil 'khor ma lus pa bla ma rdo rje slob dpon nyid la dbyer med du rdzogs

118)par mthong bas byin rlabs zhugs tshul nan tar bzang bar byung zhing*/ nam mkha'i snying po'i me tog shar yang dag thugs kyi dkyil 'khor la babs pas grub rtags nam mkha' la 'phur zhing nyi zer rta ru gzhon nus pa dang*/ gnubs ban sangs rgyas ye shes ni lho 'jam dpal sku'i dkyil 'khor la babs pas/ brag la phur pa btab pa dang nyi zla'i steng du gshegs bzhud mdzad/ rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyi padma gsung gi dkyil 'khor 'grub pas rta mgrin gyi skur dngos su ston zhing rta skad kyi 'dzam gling khyab par bsgrags/ mtsho rgyal gyi me tog byang gi phur pa phrin las la babs pa de slar yar nas lho nub rig 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor la babs pa'i rten 'brel gyis bsad gso'i sta stangs grub cing tshe'i rig 'dzin kyang thob/ 'brog mi dpal gyi ye shes shar lho bla med he ru ka la babs pas ting 'dzin 119)gcig gis nyin zhag mang por 'da' zhing snang srid kyi ma mo thams cad bran du 'khol nus/ rlungs dpal gyi seṅges nub byang dreg pa kun 'dul la babs pas 'jig rten dregs pa can thams cad las la 'gyed pa dang thun mong gi dngos grub ci 'dod kyi bza' btung dang rin chen gyi char 'beb nus par byung*/ bai ro tsa na byang shar stobs ldan nag po'i dkyil 'khor la babs pas/ mchog gi dngos grub zag med 'od lus 'grub cing*/ thun mong gi ngag gi bden tshig grub/ gnyags dzñā na ku mā ra ni che mchog yon tan bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor la babs pas sku'i bkod pa gcig las mang por sprul zhing bsdu ba dang mi snang ba'i sprul bsgyur sogs la dbang thob cing*/ brag skam la phyag mdzub btsugs nas bdud rtsi'i chu dbyung ba lnga la dbang bsgyur ba ste/ de ltar bod kyi bka' 120)babs dgu la slob dpon rin po ches sgrub ba bka' brgyad zab mo'i dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag gnang nas rgyud smin gron du gyur pa la gang zag snyan khung gi rgyud pa ces bya'o/

lnga pa smon lam dbang bskur gter chos kyi rgyud tshul ni/ snyigs dus 'gro ba'i skyabs su mchog padma 'byung gnas kyi skal pa rtsod ldan tha mar skyes pa'i sems can las nyon rgyu 'bras la spyod pa rnams la thugs brtse bas dgongs te de las skyob phyir bde gshegs thams cad 'dus pa'i rgyud lung rnams kyi dgongs pa'i snying po sgrub thabs man ngag skyed rdzogs smin grol lag len du gtan la phab par mdzad pa'i bka' brgyad kyi chos skor la/ bde gshegs 'dus pa/ gsang ba yongs rdzogs/ rang byung rang shar/ thugs kyi me long*/ bla med kun 'dus/ dgos 'dod kun 'byung*/ rdo rje rwa sbag dregs pa yongs 'dul 121)dngos grub 'dus pa/ yang gsang bla med/ khro mkhar ma dang rdzong phreng la sogs sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi chos skor rgyas bsdus mtha' yas pa zhig gter shog la bkod cing byin rlabs rab gnas bka' gtad smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar nas gter gnas so sor sbas pa rnams bka' babs gang yin gyi gter ston sprul sku rim par byon pa rnams kyi gter nas gdan drangs shing 'gro ba'i don rgya cher mdzad tshul mngon sum tshad mar gyur pa 'di lags mod kyi/ ༈ da lam gyi skabs la babs pa'i sgrub pa bka' brgyad yang dril dngos grub snying po 'di nyid ni gu ru rin po ches rdzogs chen gyi rnal 'byor myang ban ting 'dzin bzang po la tshe sgrub gnam lcags rdo rje dngos grub kun 'dus kyi zab chos gnang ba'i skabs su/ dper na/ 'jig rten na tshong 122)pa nor che yang nor la dgra sdang bas dgra 'jigs skyob pa'i skyal ma gal che ba'i dpe ltar/ tshe'i sgrub pa dngos grub che yang bar chad sel ba'i cha rkyen la dgongs te gnang nas nyags lung ljon pa'i gnas sgor gter du sbas pa las/ myang ban gyi sprul pa gter ston chen po 'ja' tshon snying po gdan drangs pa'i byin rlabs kyi ngad ma yal ba 'di lta bu ni gter chos smon lam dbang bskur gyi rgyud pa ces bya ste/

gu ru rin po ches gter ston de nyid la dang por myang ban la bka' gtad/ lung bstan/ smon lam btab pa la brten nas sku tshe 'di la zab gter dang mjal zhing dngos nyams mnal lam thams cad la yang padma 'od kyi gzhal yas su gu ru nyid dang mjal zhing byin gyis rlob par mdzad pas na bla rgyud kyi phreng ba mang po 'dren mi dgos shing dam sel brgyud pas bar ma 123)chad pa'i yid ches khungs btsun gyi gtan tshig de ltar lags pas dad mos nges shes kyi gdung shugs bskyed de gsol ba gdab pa'i tshig 'di'i rjes zlos mdzad par zhu/ hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bde gshegs rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ bdag cag dad pas 'jug par 'tshal/ thugs rjes dkyil 'khor du bzhugs gsol/

zhes gsol ba gdab pa'i mjug tu/ 'bru'i me tog sil ma lag tu gtad nas/ de ltar lha dang bla ma dbyer med rdo rje'i slob dpon la gsol ba btab pa sngon du song nas slob dpon gyis kyang thugs rje'i dgongs pas rjes su gnang ba yin pas na/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la rig pa'i me tog phul ba'i mtshon byed du me tog sil ma 'di nyid tham mo sbyar ba'i bar du bzung nas/ rang rang gi tshe rab mang po'i gong nas bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i las 'phro gang la mchis 124)pa kho nar me tog 'bul ba'i 'dun pas tshig 'di rjes zlos mdzad pa'i mthar me tog dkyil 'khor la 'thor bar mdzod cig ho/ rnal 'byor rig pa'i me tog 'di/ dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul lags na/ sngon nas las 'phro gang yod pa'i/ yi dam lha la babs par shog de wa ā be shā ya aḥ ces me tog 'khor la/ 'o/ de ltar me tog phul ba rnams dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi bdag nyid kun bzang che mchog he ru ka'i thugs kar babs pa yin te/ ci'i phyir na/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor ye shes rnam pa dgu'i rang 'od las grub pa'i tshom bu dgu'i lha tshogs ma lus pa rnams gtso mchog nyid kyi rang mdangs las gzhan ma yin te/ ji ltar nyi ma'i dky-il 'khor gyi 'od stong phyogs bcur 'phro ba thams cad nyi ma kho na'i rang 'od las gzhan gang yang ma yin pa bzhin te/ ci'i phyir khyed 125)rang rnams kyi yi dam lha'i skal par dpal chen po che mchog ho ru nyid bsnyen cing bsgrub par byos la/ lha dang mi 'bral ba'i rtags su gnas gsum du yig 'bru gsum gyi mtshan ma btab cing*/ gsang ba'i mtshan gdags pa 'di ni dper na lcags la gser 'gyur gyi rdzas byugs pa tsam gyis lcags nyid gser gyi dngos par 'gyur ba ltar/ khyed rang rnams kyi phung khams skye mched yi dam lha'i ngo bor gnas bsgyur ba'i thabs kyi bye brag lags pas de ltar nges par gyis la/

gsang ba'i mtshan yang rdo rje che mchog 'dus pa rtsal zhes ma brjed par 'dzin 'tshal/ zhes/ dri bzang gi chu'am bdud rtsi sman gyi ka pā la nas blangs pa slob dpon gyis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i 'drin lag gis slob ma'i dpral mgrin snying gar thig le bya'o/ de nas ye shes 'bebs pa'i yo byad spos dang rol mo sogs lta gon byas nas/ ༈ de nas khyed 126)rang rnams la dbang gi dngos gzhi ye shes kyi lha dbab pa'i phyir/ lus gnad skyil krung mnyam bzhag lta stangs dang ldan pa'i ngang nas sngar nas rlung sbyor goms na kha sbyor bum pa can 'dzin pa dang*/ de ltar yi shes na dbug rang sor bzhag nas sems kyi rtogs pa gzhan du skad cig kyang ma yengs par dmigs pa 'di ltar sgom par zhu/ de yang khyed rang rnams skad cig dran rdzogs su nam mkha' la 'ja' shar ba bzhin du dpal chen he ru ka rigs 'dus phyag rgya mchog gi skur gyur te/ de yang sku mdog mthing la smug pa'i mdangs kyis brjid pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu pas g.yon thod pa khrag gis bkang ba dkrug pa'i tshul du bsnams pa/ zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mchi bdag gtsigs shing spyan gsum sdang mig glog ltar 'khyug pa'i smin ma 127)dang sma ra me lce 'bar ba/ dbu skra kham nag nam mkhar 'phyo zhing thod skam rigs lnga rtse bran 'od zer 'bar bas brgyan pa/ snyan cha mgur chu phyag zhabs kyi rgyan du rin po che dang rus rgyan sbrul gyi chun bus spras pa/ sku la glang chen ko rlon mi pags g.yang gzhi stag lpags sham thabs te bgo ba'i go gsum dang*/ thod pa skam rlon rnyid pa'i 'phreng ba tshar gsum dang*/ thal chen rakta zhag gi zo ris te byugs pa'i rdzas gsum dang*/ rdo rje'i gshog pa dang ye shes kyi me dpung ste dpa' ba'i rtags gnyis dang bcas te dpal gyi chas rnams sku la rdzogs par brgyan zhing*/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gi dor stabs kyis pad nyi'i gdan la bzhengs shing 'gyings pa/

yum chen khro mo gnam zhal ma mthing ga cha lugs yab dang mtshungs pa'i phyag g.yas yab kyi 128)mgul nas mkhyud cing g.yon pas thod khrag yab kyi zhal du stobs pa/ zhabs g.yas pa yab dang mnyam par bshis cing g.yon pa yab la 'khril ba/ yab yum gnyis ka snang la rang bzhin med pa gar gu'i nyams ldan gzi brjid gtum brngams kyi dpal du 'bar bar gsal ba'i thugs kar padma sngon po 'dab brgyad kyi gdan la nyi ma'i steng du thugs srog hūm̐ mthing nag gi mtha' skor du yang hūm̐ mthing brgyad kyis bskor bar gsal/ spyi bo'i steng gi nam mkhar pad zla'i gdan ma chos sku kun bzang yab yum tsha 'khor du rgyud pa lnga ldan gyi bla ma rig 'dzin grub thob rgyud pa thams cad 'ja' 'od thibs se bzhugs pa mos pa mdzod cig de nas bdag rdo rje slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer dang*/ khyed rang rnams kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas bla ma sku gsum rgya bod kyi grub thob rig 'dzin sogs rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma thams cad spyan 129)drangs te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i bla ma rnams la thim/ de dag thams cad kyang 'od kyi gong bur gyur te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi gtsug tu thim pa'i mos pa rtse gcig tu mdzod cig ces dmigs pa sprad pa ltar slob dpon gyis kyang ting 'dzin gtad cing gu ru'i tshig bdun gsol 'debs kyi mthar/ oṃ gu ru sarba pa ma ya ā we sha ya/ a bhi ṣiñtsa aḥ.aḥ.aḥ zhes rol che dang bcas te bstim mo/ de nas khye rang rnams kyi 'od zer phyogs bcu mtha' med du 'phros pas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad yid dam zhi ba dam pa rig brgya/ sangs rgyas zhi bcu rtsa gnyis/ de nyid du rigs lnga/ gsang chen rigs gcig la sogs pa'i rnam par byon te khyed rang rnams kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ la gnyis med du thim pa'i mos pa mdzod cig oṃ sarba tā thā ga ta de wa shintaṃ ka sa ma ya ā we sha ya aḥ.aḥ

zhes nan tan du 130) bstim/ de nas yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig dgu las 'od 'phros/ rgyud sde bzhi drug gi yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dang chos srung dam can rgya mtshor bcas pa rnams dang khyad par du bde gshegs sgurab pa bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs bdun brgya nyer lnga sprul pa yang sprul nyid sprul bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas te drag char rlung gis skyod pa ltar byon nas khyed rang rnams kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig dgu la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa rtse gcig tu mdzod cig oṃ ma hā shrī he ru ka sa pā ri wa ra/ ā be sha ya du ti te/ badzra ga ma a nutta ram/ ā be sha ya ā be sha ya/ to pā ya to pā ya/ ra ra tsa la ha dza hūm̐ āḥhā dzheṃ swā hā/ zhes rol mo drag po dang bcas pas bstim zhing*/ gal che zhing 'dzom na ye shes 'bebs pa'i rdzas sbyor gyi du bas bdug pa sogs kyang bya 131) gsungs la/ mthar/ me tog 'thor zhing rdo rje spyi bor bzhag nas tiṣtha badzra gyi sngags dang bcas pas brtan par bya'o/ de ltar ye shes dbab pa 'di gsang sngags kyi dbang la gal po cher gsungs kyang*/ gzhung gi dbang chog tu brda tsam las ma bstan par snang bas 'dir bka' brgyad gter rnying dag nas kha bkangs lags se/ de nas slob dpon gyis dbang bum gdan drangs la/ de ltar skal ldan gyi bu rnams la dbang gis ye shes dbab cing bstim nas/ da ni slar yang de las mi 'da' zhing mi 'bral ba'i rgyas gdab pa'i dbang rnams rim can du bskur ba yin pas/ des na khyed rang rnams sngar bzhin dpal chen po'i skur gsal bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ dbang rdzas kyi bum pa 'di'i nang gzhal yas khang dgu rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dngos su bzhugs pa khyed kyi gtsug tu bzhag pa'i tshe/ lha rnams 'od du zhu ba'i bdud rtsi'i 132)chu rgyun nar gyi byung ste spyi gtsug tshangs bug tu/

zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad bdud rtsis mer gyis gang nas/ tshe rabs thog med kyi las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dag cing*/ yi dam lha dang gnyis su med pa'i go 'phang thob par mos pa mdzad 'tshal lo/ hūm̐/ bkra shis bum pa rin rgyan/ bde gshegs zhi khro 'od du zhu/ skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas/ sgo gsum bag chags sgrib byang shog oṃ sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes spyi bor dbang bskur zhing bum chu thig pa spyi gtsug ru btig cing khyad par blud do/ de nas rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan 'thogs nas/ de ltar bum pas dbang bskur bas bdud rtsi'i chus lus khengs shing chu lhag gyen du lud pa las rims kyi bdag po rgyal ba rnam pa lngas dbu rgyan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐/ sku gsung thugs yon phrin las lnga/ sku lnga ye shes dug lnga 'dzoms/ dbu 133)rgyan rigs lngas dbang bskur pas/ nyon mongs bag chags dag par shog oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes spyi bor bskur ro/ de nas phyag mtshan rdor dril 'thogs la/ de ltar khyod rnams la phung khams lhar byin rlabs shing rigs bdag gi rgyas btabs pa ni rgyal bu rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur khrus gsol zhing cod pan bcings pa dang chos mtshungs la/ da ni bka' rtags kyi phyag rgya gtad pa dang mtshungs par rdor dril lag tu gtad pas thabs shes zung 'jug gi sgo nas 'gro ba'i don la spyod nus par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐/ ye shes lnga ldan rdo rje dang*/ gsung dbyangs grags stong dril bu gnyis/ thabs shes zung 'jug dbang bskur bas/ mnyam nyid dbyer med dbang thob shog dzñā na badzra ghaṣḍe a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ āḥ zhes g.yas g.yon du gtad nas rdo rje gser zhing dril bu 'khrol du 134) gzhug go de nas mchod pa rnams lnga sman raka gtor ma rnams mkhar gzhong lta bu'i nod mi bag gcig tu bcug nas lag tu gtad cing*/ de nas phyi nang gi mchod rdzas yongs rdzogs gtad pas ni rgyal srid kyi mnga' thang longs spyod thams cad 'bogs pa dang chos mtshungs pas/

khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐/ sman raka gtor ma mchod pa'i rdzas/ dam rdzas yongs rdzogs dbang bskur bas/ lha dang dam rdzas bsten mchod dang*/ sgom sgrub 'chad nyan dbang thob shog sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥhūm̐/ de nas dur khrod chas brgyad rnams gtad cing*/ de ltar rgyas par dbang bskur nas rgyal po'i cha byad dang dpal brjid kyi gos rgyan rnams gyon par dbang ba ltar/ dpal chen khro rgyal 'bar ba'i rgyan chas rtags kyi rdzas rnams gtad cing bkon pas/ ma mo mkha' 'gro rnams kyis rje dang gtso bor bskur ba dang*/ 'jig rten khams kyi dregs pa can thams cad dbang du 'dud zhing zil gyis gnon nus 135)par gyur pa'i nges shes mdzod cig hūm̐/ de ring skal ldan bu khyod la/ ko rlon zhing pags thod phreng dang*/ sbrul chun stag sham la sogs la/ dpal gyi chas dbang bskur thob shog oṃ shrī he ru ka a bhi ṣīñtsa sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐ swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐bam̐ ho/ de ltar bu phyi thun mong rdzas kyi dbang bhmas rim par bskur nas/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal bu rgyal sar dbang bskur ba ji lta bas khyed rnams chogs kyi rgyal srid la bkod cing mnga' gsol ba'i byin rlabs mthu 'bras kyis/ dam pa chos kyi rgyal khab su mngon par sangs pa'i go 'phang thob nas nam mkha' mnyam pa'i 'gro ba'i ded dpon chen por 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel gyi sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin pas de ltar thugs la nges mdzod/ ces brjod cing shis brjod mdor bsdus kyang bya'o/ de ltar phyi dbang rnams legs par thob nas/ da ni gsangs sngags 136)nang dbang zab mo bskur ba la ste/ yi dam lha'i dbang gi sku mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor byin gyis rlobs pa dang*/ bzlas lung gsang ba'i dbang gis gsung mi zad rgyan 'khor du bya ba dang*/ shes rab brda'i dbang gis thugs mi zad rgyan 'khor du rtogs par byed pa rnams kyi dang por phyag rgya lha'i dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/

zhes maṇḍal phul ba'i rjes la slob dpon gyis gtso mchog sku gdan drangs te/ khyod rang rnams kyi lus gdos bcas gzugs kyi phung po ma dag mtshan 'dzin gyi bag chags sbyangs shing yi dam lha'i skur gsal btabs/ byin gyis rlabs/ dbang bskur/ rgyas gdab pa sogs bgyis pa'i don rnams dran par byos la/ slar yang lha la lha bstim pa nan tan du bgyi ba yin pas/ de yang mdun gyi dkyil 'khor 'di nyid 'dus byas kun rdzob rdzas kyi dngos po tsam du ma mdzin par ye shes rang byung sprul pa'i gzhal 137)yas khang chos nyid rol pa chen po'i pho brang rgyan dang bkod pa phun gsum tshogs pa'i dbus kyi dkyil 'khor snying po'i gtso mchog 'khor 'das ma lus pa'i khyab bdag kun bzang chen mchog he ru ka'i sku las rang 'dra'i sku sgyu 'phrul gar dgu'i nyams kyi rol pa nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi mdangs ltar 'bar ba byon te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i gtsug tu thim pa'i mos gus rtse gcig mdzod/ hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor yongs kyi gtso bo che ba'i mchog bcom ldan dpal chen kun bzang he ru ka yab yum sras dang bcas pas dbang bskur bas/ skal ldan bu la mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ oṃ badzra kro dha mahā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho a bhi ṣīñtsa aḥ zhes rol mo bsgrag cing dpon slob gnyis kas ring 'dzin dag ldan pas spyi gtsug ru dbang bskur zhing bstim mo/ de ltar gtso bo gzhan thams cad la rig 'gre ste/ de nas lho phyogs 138)kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i gtso bo 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshod las rang 'dra'i sku 'phros te khyed rang rnams kyi dpral ba'i gnas su thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor yongs kyi sku mchog gshin rje'i tsha shed/ yab yum sras dang bcas pas dbang bskur bas/ sku lnga lhun grub ye shes lnga dang ldan/ skal ldan su la sku yi dngos grub stsol/

oṃ a kro te ya mātna ka hūm̐ phaṭaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho/ a bhi ṣīñtsa aḥ zhes dpral bar bskur ro/ de nas nus phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor dbus nas dpal chen rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal po las rang 'dri'i sku byon te khyod kyi mgrin pa'i gnas su thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor yongs kyi gsung mchog dbang chen sku/ yab yum sras dang bcas pas dbang bskur bas/ 'gag med gsung dbyangs 'gro kun dbang du bsdud/ skal ldan bu la gsung gi dngos grub stsol/ 139)oṃ padma ta kṛd ha ya gri ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ mgrin par bskur ro/ de nas yag dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs nas dpon badzra he ru ka 'phros te khyed kyi snying gar thim par sgom mdzod cig hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor yongs kyi thugs mchog badzra sku/ yab yum sras dang*/ gsal stong mtha' bral zung 'jug rdo rje'i thugs/ skal ldan bu la thug sa kyi/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ phaṭaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho a bhi= zhes snying khar bskur ro/ yang*/ byang phyogs dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo phrin las rdo rje gzhon nu las rang 'dra'i sku 'phros nas lte bar thim par sgom mdzod/ hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor yongs kyi phrin las phur pa'i sku/ rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum sras dang bcas/ byin rlabs thog med nus mthu'i dbang bskur bas/ skal ldan bu la phrin las dngos grub stsol/ o badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bignan bam hūm̐ phaṭaḥ 140)dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho a bhi=

zhes lte bar bskur ro/ de nas shar lho'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo bla med he ru ka 'phros nas gsang ba'i gnas su thim par sgom mdzod/ hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bla med he ru ka ma mo thod gtong tshogs kyi dbus na bzhugs/ lha mo mo rgyud mkha' 'gro kun 'dus dbang*/ skal ldan bu la mkha' 'gro dngos= oṃ gud hya dzñā na shrī he ru ka kro dhi shwa ri st+wam ma ma ye gi nā hūm̐ phaṭa/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho/ a bhi= zhes bas gsang bar bskur ro/ yang*/ lho nub kyi dkyil 'khor nas rig 'dzin slob dpon gyi sprul pa 'phros nas spyi gtsug tu thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor yongs kyi bla ma thod phrengartsal/ rgya bod grub thob rtsa rgyud gu ru rnams/ yab yum sras bcas thugs rje'i byin rlabs dbang*/ skal ldan bu la dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ oṃ badzra gu ru padma sarba siddhi hūm̐ phaṭa: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho a= zhes spyi gcug tu bskur ro/ 141)nub byang gi dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu'i dkyil 'khor gyi mnga' bag dpal dregs pa kun 'dul las rang 'dra'i sprul pa 'phros te khyed kyi sprus mo g.yas su thim par sgom mdzod cig hūm̐/ dpal chen khro rgyal dregs pas kun 'dul ni/ yab yum sras dang 'khor tshogs thams cad kyis/ chos skyongs srung ma las la 'khol ba dang*/ skal ldan bu la mthu rtsal dngos grub stsol/ oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa sarba duṣṭaṃ hūm̐ phaṭaḥdzaḥhūm̐ ho a bhi= zhes sus mo g.yas su bskur ro/ dkyil 'khor byang shar gyi gtso bo dpen stobs ldan nag po las rang 'dra'i sprul pa 'phros pa sprus mo g.yon par thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐ dpal chen khro rgyal stub nag po ni/ yab yum sras dang 'khor bcas mus pas/ 'jig rten dregs pa 'dul ba'i dngos grub ni/ skal ldan bu 142)la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs/ oṃ sarba yakā yam ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ dzaḥhū bam̐ ho a bhi ṣīñtsa aḥ

zhes sus mo g.yon du bskur ro/ de nas yang gtso mchog gi sku dpung g.yas g.yon gyi sprul pa'i khyung chen dkar nag gnyis las rang 'dra'i sprul pa re 'phros nas khyed kyi dpung pa gnyis la thim par sgom mdzod/ hūm̐ khroṃ/ bya khyung rgyal po dkar nag gnyis/ rdo rje'i mchu la ral gri'i spu lcags kyu'i sder mo gnam lcags ra/ sa bdag klu 'dul dbang thob shig khroṃ ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho a bhi ṣīñtsa āḥ zhes dpung pa g.yas g.yon la bskur zhing thim mo/ de nas slar yang dkyil 'khor dgu'i lha tshogs bdun brgya nyer lnga thams cad ma lus pa'i ska so so las mar me gcig las gnyis su ched pa'am/ nam mkha'i zla ba mtsho rjing gi nang du snang ba ltar rdzu 'phrul sku'i snang ba brnyan re re khyed 143)rang rnams so so la thim pas phung khams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por gzod nas lhun gis grub bzhin pa la slar yang gsal thebs shing byin rlabs kyi nus stobs chos cher 'phel bar 'gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod cig ces brjod la drag sngags spyi dril chen mo tshar gcig brjod cing rol mo bsgrag me tog 'thor ro/ de ltar lha sku phyag rgya'i dbang gi lus sprul pa skur byin gyis rlabs nas/ gnyis pa bzlas lung gsang ba'i dbang gis ngag smin par byed pa la/ dkyil 'khor dgu'i lha rnams kyi thugs khar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ dang sngags phreng sku mdog dang mtshungs par 'khor ba rnams gyen du nar gyi byung bas zhal gyi sgo nas 'thon pa khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs te ljags kyi steng pad zla la sngags kyi 'khor lo lu gu rgyud du 'khor bar bsgom zhing sngags kyi rjes zlos kyang 144)mdzad pa 'tshal/ zhes/ 'phreng ba'i sna re nas dpon slob gnyis ka bzung la/ rgyas par las gzhung gi 'dzab ltar dpal dgu so so'i snying po bzlas lung 'bog pa'am/ mdor bsdu na/

oṃ badzra ma ha kro dha padma kro dhī shwa ri badzra kī li kī la ya ma hā ya ksha ka la rū pa karma ram ram dzwa la ram hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces tshar gsum rjes zlos slob ma nges shes na dpon slob mgrin gcig tu lan bdun bzla yang rung ngo*/ gsang dbang dngos ni/ kā pa la bdud rtsi a mṛ ta dza gad mngar gsum sbyar bas gang ba ba 'thogs te/ ༈ de nas phyogs dus kyi rgyal ba thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo dgongs brda snyan rgyud kyi bla ma thams cad drin can rtsa ba'i bla mar ro gcig pa nyid dpal chen po che mchog yab yum gyi skur bzhengs te ma chags thabs kyi rol pa ma mnyam sbyor bde chen gyis longs spyod mdzad pa'i dngos grub byang sems kyi bdud rtsi 'di skal ldan bu la byin pas 145)ngag za mal gyi bag chags las sgrib nyes tshogs thams cad dag cing*/ rtsa rlung thig le bde ba chen por byin gyis brlabs pa'i nges shes bskyed mdzod cig hūm̐/ bla ma bde gshegs yab yum rnams/ gnyis med sbyor ba'i byang sems 'dis/ skal ldan ngag la dbang bskur bas/ gsang ba'i dbang mchog thob par shog oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta/ ma hā sukha a we sha ya aḥ.aḥ zhes/ mgrin par dbang bskur zhing bdud rtsi blud dngos/ de nas ye shes kyi rigs ma'i sku gzugs 'thogs la/ de ltar gsang dbang ngag la bskur bas ngag longs spyod rdzogs skur byin rlabs nas/ gsum pa shes rab ye shes dbang gis yid smin par bya ba la/ gang zag gi rgyud rigs nus pa sogs kyi rim pa dang 'tshams pa'i bskur thabs kyi phyag bzhes kyang rgyas bsdus ji snyed gcig mchis na'ang*/ skabs 146)'dir babs pa ni brda dang mtshon byed la brten nas don gyi skal pa can du sgrub pa'i thabs yin te/ des na khyed cag rnams dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po gtso mchag he ru ka dngos kyi 'du shes dang ma bral bar mdzad pa'i ngang nas/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi yum gyur chos thams cad kyi 'byung gnas bde ba'i ye shes mchog gi gsang mdzod du gyur pa yum chen mo gnam zhal dbyings phyug ma'i sku'i zlos gar mtshan dpe'i shar ba'i de nyid gtad pa la brten nas/

bla na med pa'i myur lam zab mo'i snod ldan du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐/ mtshan ldan yid 'ong grogs mchog 'di/ bstane pas bde stong rgyud la skye/ thig le dbab bzung 'dren 'gram gyis/ bde chen lhan skyes rtogs par shog a ho su kha ho/ zhes gtad la/ hūm̐/ yab yum gnyis ka snang stong lha/ 147) rdo rje padma byin rlabs te/ dbab 'dzin 'dren bkram 'phrul 'khor gyis/ bde stong rang ngo shes par byos/ a nu rā ga badzra dzñā na atma ko3haṃ/ de yang khams gsum gyi sems can spyi dang khyad par 'dod khams kyi 'gro ba thams cad rgyu dug gsum chags snang la brten zhing*/ rkyen pha ma'i mtshams sbyor gyi mthu las 'bras bu skye 'gro pho mor snang ba ni brda dang sbyang gzhi yin la/ de las chags sdang gi rtog pa sbyang phyir du/ lha yab dang yum/ chos thabs dang shes rab/ rdzas rdo rje dang dril bu la sogs kyi bye brag thams cad ni mtshon byed kyi rtags dang sbyong byed yin zhing*/ de dag la brten pa'i nyams len gnad du bsnun pas ni spang bya dang gnyen po dbyer med du 'dres pas chags sdang gi rtsa ba zad/ bde ba dang sdug bsngal sems thog tu ro mnyam 148)pas dgag sgrub kyi 'dzin pa zhig pho mo/ bdag gzhan/ yab yum/ snang stong sogs kyi dbye gzhi dang dbye mkhan gdod nas ma grub pa'i dbyings dang ye shes lhan thugs rje zung du 'jug pa'i rang ngo ye ji bzhin pa'i gnas lugs mthong ba ni mtshon bya'i don dang sbyang 'bras kyi snying po yin tshe/ de ltar rtogs pa'i thabs dang rten 'brel rgyud la bzhag pa yin pas na shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhes bya'o/ zhes/ sher dbang gi don gyi ye shes ngo sprod pa'i sa bcad ma ltongs tsam gyis bskur ba las/ dpe'i ye shes la brten nas dga' bzhi lugs 'byung lugs ldog sogs kyi ngo sprod rgyas bshad mang po zhig gsum pa'i dbang chog rnams su 'byung mod kyang*/

da lta'i gang zag phal mo che'i skal bar ma babs pas 'di tsam gyis chog par dge'o/ ༈ de nas slar yang dbang thams cad kyi mthar thugs bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che'i brda mtshon byed me long 149) shel rdo lhan cig 'thogs te/ hūm̐/ sems nyid ka dag lhun grub don/ snang stong zung 'jug sgyu ma'i sku/ gdod nas yongs dag gnyug ma'i gshis/ yang dag nges don rtogs par shog dzñā na pañtsa kā ya a bhi ṣīñtsa aḥ.aḥ.aḥ zhes snying gar dbang bskur zhing*/ slar yang dbang don bshad de/ de ltar chos skur grol bar byed pa shes rab ye shes dang bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che brda dang mtshon byed tsam du bskur yang don gyi dngos gzhi ngo ma 'phrod na dbang gi gzugs brnyan tsam du gyur nas dgos pa mi 'byung phyir/ brda nyid don la 'byor bas gal tshe bas na/ de yang me long dang shel rdo'i dpe la ltos dang*/ med bzhin snang ba'i gzugs brnyan kha dog du mar gsal ba shar yang*/ shar ba nyid dngos par ma grub pa'i stong par 'dug pa dpe 'di ji lta bar rang gi sems nyid ye 150)nas dngos po dang mtshan mar grub pa rdul phra rab tsam yang med la/ med pa'i rang gdangs 'gags med kyi gsal snang tshogs su shar gang ltar 'char yang don la bden pas dben pas dben pa 'di ni sems nyid kyi gnas su shar gang ltar 'char yang don la bden pas dben pa 'di ni sems nyid kyi gnas lugs sam chos nyid yin pa dang*/ de yang sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi ngo bor rang bzhin thugs rje nyid du ye nas lhun grub tu bzhugs pa yin te/ de gang yin na/ sems kyi ngo bo stong pa spros mtshan las 'das pa'i dbyings ni chos sku/ de'i rang mdangs ye shes 'gag med gsal rig tu snang ba ni longs sku gsal stong dbyer med kyi rtsal las 'khor 'das kyi rtogs tshogs cir yang 'char ba ni sprul sku ste/ de gsum yang tha dad ma yin par da lta'i tha mal shes pa bzo bcos ma byas rkyen gyis ma bsgyur 'dzin pas ma bslad pa'i ring ngo hrig ge

yer re re/ rjen ne ba 'di ka las gzhan 151)gang mang yod pa ma yin pas/ 'di ni sku gsum dbyer med ngo bo nyid kyi sku yang yin la/ rigs dang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi bdag nyid kun bzang che mchog he ru ka yang 'di yin no/ 'di las 'khor 'das thams cad 'byung bas na sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs bdun brgya nyer lnga yang 'dir 'dus so/ 'di nyid rang ngo rang gis shes na dbang thams cad kyi snying po tshig dbang rig po che'am rig pa rtsal gyi dbang dam pa thob pa yin no/ de thob pas ni snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos ma lus pa la dbang bsgyur ba yin phyir chos nyid don gyi dbang yang dag pa thob pa yin pas de ltar shes par mdzod cig de nas rjes gnang mtha' rten phrin las las sbyor drag po sgrol dbang gi mtshon byed tsam du/ lcags phur lag tu gtad cing*/ de ltar dpal chen bka' brgyad 'dus pa'i dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs su thob pa'i mtha' rten phrin las 152)drag po gdug pa 'dul byed phur pas dbang bskur ba yin pas/ lcags phur 'di nyid ngo bo dpal chen po che mchog lha dgu la rnam pa las byed sprul pa'i sras mchog badzra kī la ya sku stod khro bo chen po zhal gcig phyag gnyis phur bu 'dril ba la sku smad gnam lcags kyi phur pa mgar gyi sol mas nas drangs ma thag ltar me'i tsha tshang phro ba can du gsal ba' 'di khyed kyi lag tu gtad cing dril ba tsam gyis/ ma rungs gdug pa'i dgregs tshar gcod pa'i nus pa thob par sgom mdzod cig hūm̐/ phrin las ma lus sgrub pa'i rdzas/ drag po'i lcags phur lhar gsal nas/ drag sngags bzla zhing dril bar bya/ phrin las thogs med dbang thob shog oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bignan bam hūm̐ phaṭaḥ mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭaḥhūm̐ ka ra hūm̐ aḥ 'di skabs bka' brgyad kyi dbang rgyas pa rnams su ling chen la dgug gzhug 153) gdab las rgyas par byas pa'i mthar gtso bo dgu dang las phur brgya rtsa brgyad rnams kyis phur skor dang bcas te drag po sgrol dbang bskur ba yin mod kyang*/

'dir ni spros pa nyer bsdu'i skabs yin tshe 'di tsam gyi chog pa'o/ de yang bsgral las thams cad kyi rtsa ba ni rtogs pas bsgral ba dang thugs rjes gzhan bsgral ba gnyis yin la/ sgrol ba'i thabs kyang don chos nyid kyis bsgral ba dang rtags cho gas bsgral ba gnyis dang ldan dgongs pa las/ de la dang por rtogs pas bdag bsgral ba ni/ rang rgyud kyi ma rig pa nga'am bdag tu 'dzin pa 'di khams gsum 'khor ba'i rtsa ba yin zhing byang chub tu mi ster ba'i gnod byed ni 'di kho na yin phyir/ 'di nyid rang rig pa byang chub sems kyi phur pa sku gsum dbyer med kyi dpal dang ldan pas chos nyid gnas lugs kyi hom khungs su ma bcos mnyam nyid kyi ting 'dzin gyis bsgral 154)ba ni don chos nyid kyis bsgral tshul yin pas bsgral las kun gyi thog mar 'di nyid gnad du thebs dogs pa dang*/ de la rang dbang thob nas thugs rjes gzhan sgrol ba ni/ spyir khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can/ sgo du log rtogs gdug pa can gyi gdul bya rnams la/ zhe sdang khong khor gnod sems kyis ma yin par bla med byang chub la bgod slad 'ba' zhig dpa'i blos kun nas bslang ste/ lta ba'i rdzong la gzhi bca'/ sgom pa'i phrang gi gnad bzung*/ spyod pa'i srog gi man ngag gtan la phab nas log spyod kyi skye 'gro rnams kyi las ngan gyi sa bon rgyun bcad cig tshogs gnyis kyi shing rta thar gling du bskyod pa'i thabs kyi cho gas gdul bya byang chen la 'god pa la thugs rje gzhan sgrol ba zhes bya ba ste/ de lta bu'i gnad don rgyud la sbyor 'tshal lo/ ༈ de ltar bde gshegs 155)kun 'dus sgrub pa bka' brgya dngos grub kyi snying po'i dbang bskur zab pa'i mthar thug pa 'di lta bu legs par thob pa yin pas na/ dbang thob pa gcig pus mi chog ste/ dbang srog dam tshig la rag las phyir dam tshig tshul bzhin srung dgos/

dbang thos nas dam tshig ma bsrungs na sman ma zhu ba dug tu gyur pa bzhin phan pa bas gnod pa che bas dam tshig gi chad pas tshe 'dir yang mi rung ba sna tshogs pa dang phyi ma rdo rje'i dmyal ba chen po nas thar ba'i dus med pa'i sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar 'gyur ba dang*/ dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrungs na gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi don kun 'bad med du 'byung zhing myur du bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur ba lags pas de lta bu'i khe nyen la bsam nas spang blang tshul bzhin bsgrub 'tshal te/ dam tshig ji ltar 156)bsrung ba'i rim pa la rgyas par ni bsam gyi mi khyab mod kyang sn-ig po 'gag dril du/ sku'i dam tshig tu lus kyi mi dge ba spangs nas bskyed rim lha'i rnal 'byor la brtson pa dang*/ gsung gi dam tshig tu ngag sgrib mi gsog cing bsnyen sgrub pa 'bad pa dang*/ thugs kyi dam tshig tu yid kyi mi dge ba mtha' dag dang khyad par gsang sngags kyi chos la log lta spang zhig skyed rdzogs zung 'jug bsgom/ rdo rje slob dpon la sangs rgyas thag chod pa'i dad gus kyis gang gsung gi bka' sgrub/ khams gsum sems can la pha ma'i 'du shes kyi gnod tshe spang zhing ci nus kyi phan 'dogs bya/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa la zhugs pa spyi dang khyad par bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gcig pa'i mched lcam la dag snang nying nas sbyangs te 'thab rtsod dang log lta spang ba rnams ni spyir gces pa'i dam tshig yin la/ sgos su dbang bzhi'i dmigs 157)bsal du ni/ bum dbang thob nas snod bcud tha mal du mi 'dzin par lha'i dkyil 'khor du lta gsang dbang thob nas sgra skad brjod tshig dpug gi 'byung rngub mtha' dag sngags su shes par bya sher dbang thob nas bde sdug bzang ngan gyi tshor rtogs thams cad chos dbyings lhan skyes su 'khyer zhing*/ shes rab mo rigs su 'gyur tshad la log lta dang chags sems spang*/

tshig dbang thob nas ni sgo gsum tha mal zhen 'dzin 'khrul phyir mi 'breng bar cir snang chos nyid du 'khyer ba rnams yin pas/ dam tshig 'di dag las skad cig kyang mi 'da' bar bsrung na smin grol nyam len gyi gnad don ma lus 'dir gzhol ba yin pas de ltar rgyud la 'dre bar mdzod cig

ces brjod/ de nas dbang brtan par byed pa'i bkra shis kyis tshigs su 158) bcas pa dbyangs dang bcas pas rgyas par brjod cing rten 'brel snying po bzlas pa'i me tog gi char bab/ tshogs 'khor gyi dga' ston dang btang rag gi mchod bstod/ rjes kyi las rim mtha' dag gi spyi gzhung ltar byas pas 'grub pa'o/ de ltar tshe sgrub gnam lcags rdo rje'i bar chad sel byed bka' brgyad dngos grub snying po'i dbang bos blangs nas sna tshogs rang grol gyis yi ger bkod pa sarba maṅga laṃ//
